build_unit_embedding: build a UnitEmbedding module to produce unit representations from unit type and feature tensors
build_cmd_embedding: build a CmdEmbedding module to produce command representations from command type and unit type tensors
build_advanced_cmd_embedding: build an AdvancedCmdEmbedding module to encode commands with target type, coordinates, and enemy or resource features
build_mlp_encoder: build an MlpEncoder module to create a configurable multi-layer perceptron with weight normalization and ReLU activation
build_prev_cmd_rnn: build a PrevCmdRnn module to encode a sequence of previous commands using an LSTM and return the final hidden state
